summary: The registrant filed a Form 6-K containing a stock exchange announcement that corrects prior notifications of PDMR share transactions. The filing discloses vesting of share awards to five executives (CEO, Chief Creative Officer, Chief Supply Chain Officer, President Asia, Chief of Staff), with details such as share prices, volumes, and total values. Transactions occurred on 12 August 2026 on Amsterdam and London exchanges. This is a routine insider transaction disclosure under MAR, not a special situation. No strategic event, deal, or structural change is involved. The correction only revises share prices. There is no deal to monitor; this is administrative in nature.
